title: fix(core): refuse an artifact package cycle as 422 CYCLIC_ARTIFACT_PACKAGES; install-local answers resolver refusals instead of a 500
body:
Fixes #34574
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：组合制品里的包如果互相依赖成环，安装接口现在回 422，错误码是新登记的 `CYCLIC_ARTIFACT_PACKAGES`，`details.cycle` 列出环上的包。另外，本地安装在真实运行时下遇到制品解析器的其它三种拒绝时，也按各自的 422 回答，不再回不透明的 500。
- 为什么改：以前作者只拿到一个不说原因的 500，要翻服务端日志才知道是循环依赖，或是 `packages` 写错了。
- 风险与回滚：只改了被拒绝的请求怎么回答，原来能装上的制品照样能装。内核启动遇到插件循环时，报错文字与以前逐字相同。回滚就是 revert 本 PR，新错误码随之撤销。
- 先看：`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`（1c 步新增的拦截，以及 `declaredRefusalAnswer` 转发 `details`）、`packages/core/src/artifact-packages.ts`（环如何变成 422）、`packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts`（新错误码的登记行）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection exec vitest run src/marketplace-install-local-resolver-refusal-real-runtime.test.ts`，预期 5 个用例全部通过：环、`packages` 不是数组、包 id 重复这三种都回 422 和各自的错误码，合法的组合制品照常装上（200）。
- 需要你做的：无，由席位在契约档审核后落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/core`**
  - `resolvePluginOrder` now throws a cycle as `PluginOrderCycleError`. This is a new exported `Error` subclass with a `cycle` property listing the names along the cycle: each depends on the next, and the first is repeated last. The message is still `[Kernel] Circular dependency detected: NAME`, and the error carries no `code` or `status`, so kernel boot and the other callers of the sorter see no change.
  - `resolveArtifactPackageEntries` reads the cycle off that error, not off a second walk of the graph. It refuses with the envelope its sibling refusals use: `code: 'CYCLIC_ARTIFACT_PACKAGES'`, `status: 422` and `details: { cycle }`. The message names the cycle as `"a" -> "b" -> "a"` and still contains `Circular dependency detected`. Any other throw from the sorter is rethrown unchanged.
- **`@objectstack/spec`**: `CYCLIC_ARTIFACT_PACKAGES` is registered in `ERROR_CODE_LEDGER` under `@objectstack/core`, beside its three siblings, using the seat's ledger text. The generated API references were regenerated with `check:generated --fix`; only `check:docs` was stale: `content/docs/references/api/{error-code-ledger,contract,automation-api}.mdx`.
- **`@objectstack/cloud-connection`** (`POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local`)
  - Step 1c, the runtime binder's unrunnable-code judgements, now answers a refusal from the artifact resolver with that refusal, through `declaredRefusalAnswer`. Steps 2a, 2b and 2c″ already did this. An undeclared throw is still rethrown.
  - Over the real runtime, step 1c is the first step that resolves a composed bundle's packages. Before this change, every resolver refusal (all three siblings, and the cycle) left the handler as a throw there. The transport renders no 422, so it answered `500 INTERNAL_ERROR`.
  - `declaredRefusalAnswer` now also forwards the refusal's own `details`, which is how a cycle's `details.cycle` reaches the client.
- Docblocks that described the cycle as a bare `Error` are corrected in `dev-i18n.ts` and `runtime/src/artifact-collections.ts`. Both are comment-only, so those packages get no changeset entry.
- `scripts/driver-memory-census.ledger.json` gains one `mock-replacement` row, for `dev-i18n-packages-reader.test.ts`. That suite now replaces `@objectstack/driver-memory` with a not-found-throwing `vi.mock`, as five sibling plugin-dev harnesses do. Every DevPlugin boot in the file passes `driver: false`, so the real driver is never loaded. The mock exists because `check:test-source-alias` asks an edited test that reaches `dev-plugin.ts`'s lazy driver import either to pay that load at collection or to mock it. The file's old comment forbidding a mock is rewritten to say why a replacement mock is not a consumer. The seat approved this in amendment 6941981971.

## Tests

- **New pin, over the REAL runtime** (no module mock): `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-resolver-refusal-real-runtime.test.ts` drives the real install-local handler.
  - A two-package cycle answers `422 CYCLIC_ARTIFACT_PACKAGES` with `details.cycle`.
  - `packages: 'not-a-list'` answers `422 INVALID_ARTIFACT_PACKAGES`.
  - A duplicate package id answers `422 DUPLICATE_ARTIFACT_PACKAGE`.
  - In those three cases nothing is registered, ledgered or read.
  - Control: the same packages without the closing dependency install (200).
  - A probe asserts that the runtime under test really carries `collectJobsWithoutBody`.
  - It is a new file rather than a `describe` in the #34432 file because that file mocks `@objectstack/runtime` for the whole file.
- **Core**
  - `artifact-packages.test.ts` covers a two-package cycle (code, status, `details.cycle`, the message path) and a cycle path that skips packages outside the cycle and ignores an external dependency. Its control is the same packages without the closing edge, which resolve in dependency order.
  - `plugin-order.test.ts` covers `PluginOrderCycleError`'s path, unchanged message and absent `code`/`status`, and a self-dependency.
- **Tests this change forced to move**, each named:
  - `marketplace-install-local-resolver-refusal-34432.test.ts`: its cycle case pinned the cycle as an undeclared throw that is rethrown. It now pins the declared `422 CYCLIC_ARTIFACT_PACKAGES` and `details.cycle` under that file's runtime mock, where step 2a reaches the resolver first. The rethrow leg has no other producer: the resolver's only remaining non-envelope throws are `Plugin not found` and `Dependency not found`, and neither is reachable through `optionalDependencies`. The 503 control (an unreadable table) is unchanged.
  - `dev-i18n-packages-reader.test.ts`: its cycle case pinned `code` and `status` as undefined. It now pins `CYCLIC_ARTIFACT_PACKAGES`, 422 and `details.cycle`. The memory driver is now a replacement mock (see What changes).
  - `marketplace-install-local-namespace-gate-33922.test.ts`, case "UNMOVED — an artifact MEMBER's refused namespace...": this case boots the real runtime and pinned the resolver's `INVALID_ARTIFACT_PACKAGE_ENTRY` as a throw out of the handler, which is the step-1c escape this PR closes. It now asserts the answered 422 with the same code and sentence, ADR-0112 envelope-clean.

<details><summary>Test runs (b1dc2a69c, the last code commit; 8490dc5d2 adds only a merge of ui/ files from main)</summary>

- On b1dc2a69c, after a full `turbo run build`, under the verify lock (VERDICT command-exit 0):
  - spec `check:generated`: 14/14 up to date.
  - plugin-dev `test`: Test Files 10/10, Tests 89/89.
  - core `plugin-order` + `artifact-packages`: Test Files 2/2, Tests 42/42.
  - cloud-connection real-runtime + 34432 + namespace-gate-33922: Test Files 3/3, Tests 25/25.
  - `typecheck` for plugin-dev and cloud-connection: exit 0.
- Whole-package runs on 1270f90e4 + f118d4c6b, before the forced moves:
  - `typecheck` for core, cloud-connection, plugin-dev, spec and runtime: exit 0.
  - core `test`: 151 files, 3611 tests, all passed.
  - plugin-dev `test`: 10 files, 89 tests, all passed.
  - spec `test`: 847 files, 27154 passed, 1 todo.
  - objectql `artifact-load-path` + `package-source-stamp`: 2/2 files, 26/26 tests.
  - cloud-connection `test`: 1 failed of 1308. That was the namespace-gate case named above; after its move the file reads 15/15.
- The typecheck for those five packages was re-run after the forced moves: exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations, one per behaviour (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, anchor hit 1, mutation landed, restore proven blob == HEAD and git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

Every mutated file is read from source by the suite that runs, so no dist preflight is needed. The core suites import their own src. The cloud-connection suites import the handler by relative path; it reads `@objectstack/core` from dist, which was built from this head.

- A1, `artifact-packages.ts`: the cycle rethrown bare (`throw err;`). Core: 2 failed / 40 passed, the two cycle cases.
- A4, `plugin-order.ts`: the sorter throws the old bare `Error`. Core: 4 failed / 38 passed, the two `PluginOrderCycleError` cases and the two resolver cycle cases.
- A2, `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`: step 1c's call moved ahead of its `try`. Cloud-connection: 3 failed / 7 passed, the real-runtime cycle, not-a-list and duplicate cases. The control and the mocked-runtime file stay green.
- A3, `declaredRefusalAnswer`: the `details` spread deleted. Cloud-connection: 2 failed / 8 passed, the `details.cycle` assertions in both files.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **FROM → TO, measured.**
  - FROM, on 60552cd93: a two-package cycle POSTed to `/api/v1/marketplace/install-local` through a real `HonoHttpServer` raw app answered `500 {"code":"INTERNAL_ERROR","message":"Internal server error"}`. That held both under the #34432 runtime mock and over the real runtime. Over the real runtime, `packages: 'not-a-list'` and a duplicate id also answered `500 INTERNAL_ERROR`: the escape frame is `unrunnableCode` → runtime `collectJobsWithoutBody`, and `declaredEnvelopeForThrow` renders no 422.
  - TO: 422 with the resolver's own code, and `details.cycle` for a cycle.
- **Clause-②: yes (widening)**, per claim amendment 6939909352. One public error code is minted, and a 500 becomes a typed 422. Nothing that was accepted before is refused now.
- **Surface:** amendment 6941981971 added `marketplace-install-local-namespace-gate-33922.test.ts` (moved by the step-1c fix, named under Tests) and `scripts/driver-memory-census.ledger.json` (one `mock-replacement` row). `check:driver-memory-census` and `check:test-source-alias` both exit 0 on 8490dc5d2.
- **Generated:** only `check:docs` was stale after the ledger row. It was regenerated with `check:generated --fix` into `content/docs/references/api/error-code-ledger.mdx`, `contract.mdx` and `automation-api.mdx`. The other 13 artifacts were up to date, and they still were after the last `origin/main` merge, when `check:generated` was re-run.
- **Callers of `resolveArtifactPackageEntries` / `resolveArtifactPackageOrder`** (cli namespace utils, core stack-collections, metadata, objectql, plugin-dev, plugin-security, runtime, verify) now see a cycle as the typed refusal.
  - No caller in `packages/**` source reads the old message text.
  - Two tests match only `/Circular dependency detected/`: the dogfood `dataset-app-reads-module` cell 3 and core `plugin-order.test.ts:69`. The new message keeps that phrase.
  - install-local's rehydrate classifies a declared 4xx as a refusal that no restart heals, which is the correct reading for a cycle.

  - It reports 0 of 17 paths on the register and a size of 548 changed lines (+463 / -85), under 3000.
  - Separately, the claim routes the review to the contract tier because of the spec ledger row and the new export.
- On earlier heads: `check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:dts-closure` refused on build prerequisites, which a full build cleared. `check:test-source-alias` and `check:driver-memory-census` were each red once, cleared by the two test edits and the ledger row above.
